# Boston College Extends Relationship with Evolv, Investing in the Future of Campus Safety


October 29, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_0af74e988c62c2af55f4c6dc233ea29d/evolvtechnology/news/2026-10-29_Boston_College_Extends_Relationship_with_Evolv_296.pdf)


*Renewal agreement includes deployment of Evolv Express® Gen2 systems and Evolv eXpedite™ bag screening systems across Boston College Athletics venues*


WALTHAM, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: EVLV), a leading security technology company pioneering AI-powered screening solutions designed to create safer experiences, today announced a multi-year renewal of its relationship with[Boston College](https://www.bc.edu/bc-web/about.html) . As part of the agreement, Boston College has upgraded its fleet of[Evolv Express®](https://evolv.com/concealed-weapons-detection/express/) systems from Gen1 to Gen2 hardware and added three[Evolv eXpedite™](https://evolv.com/concealed-weapons-detection/expedite/) bag screening systems. The renewal reflects Boston College's continued confidence in Evolv’s mission and a shared commitment to creating safer experiences.


Home to over 30 varsity athletic programs, Boston College welcomes thousands of students, athletes, alumni, fans, and visitors to campus events each year. As the Official Fan Screening Partner of Boston College Athletics, the renewal builds a strong relationship between Boston College and Evolv. The renewal demonstrates the continued desire to help the university adapt to the evolving needs of its athletics venues and event operations. The latest investment in Express Gen2 and eXpedite reflects Boston College's continued focus on enhancing the game-day experience while supporting efficient venue operations.


"At Boston College, the safety and well-being of our students, athletes, staff, and fans are always a priority," said Matt Conway, Associate Athletics Director - Facilities and Operations at Boston College. "Our goals align with Evolv's mission of creating safer experiences, and we've found a strong partner in helping us support our community. Upgrading to Gen2 systems and adding eXpedite is a step towards our continuous commitment to providing a welcoming and positive experience for everyone who comes to our athletics venues."


"We're grateful for Boston College's continued trust in Evolv and their decision to upgrade to Express Gen2 as well as eXpedite," said John Baier, Vice President of Sports & Entertainment at Evolv Technology. "Their investment in both Express Gen2 and eXpedite highlights their commitment to continuously improving venue operations and their fan experience. We look forward to renewing our partnership with Boston College."


Boston College joins a growing number of collegiate athletics programs investing in next-generation screening technology to support both venue operations and the fan experience. The upgrade follows a broader trend across New England, including Evolv’s extended partnership Gillette Stadium, and highlights Evolv systems in the area such as at Merrimack College and the New England Conservatory of Music. Across collegiate and professional sports, venues continue to invest in technologies that support their operational goals while enhancing the experience for students, athletes, staff, and fans.


**About Boston College:**


Founded in 1863 by the Society of Jesus, Boston College is among the nation's foremost universities, and a leader in the liberal arts, scientific inquiry, and formative education. Its enrollment of approximately 9,500 undergraduate and 5,000 graduate and professional school students draws attendees from across the country and around the world. The University is composed of nine schools and colleges: Carroll School of Management, Connell School of Nursing, Lynch School of Education and Human Development, Morrissey College of Arts and Sciences, Boston College Law School, School of Social Work, School of Theology and Ministry, Woods College of Advancing Studies, and Messina College, a two-year residential program that opened in July 2024. Athletics is integral to the University's focus on the development of the whole person in mind, body, and soul. BC offers 31 men's and women's varsity sports - all of which compete at the NCAA Division I level - and perennially has one of the biggest student-athlete graduation rate of Division I NCAA universities.


**About Evolv Technology**


Evolv (NASDAQ: EVLV) is designed to transform human security by helping organizations detect potential threats, mitigate risk, and enhance safety using AI-powered security solutions with robust insights. Our technology has helped to create efficient and positive security screening experiences for the world’s most iconic venues and companies as well as schools, hospitals, and public spaces. Evolv’s mission is to create a safer world to live, work, learn, and play. Evolv’s advanced systems have scanned more than 5 billion people since 2019. Evolv Express® and Evolv eXpedite™ have been awarded the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) SAFETY Act Designation as a Qualified Anti-Terrorism Technology (QATT). Evolv and its products have been awarded numerous awards which can be viewed on our[Certifications and Awards](https://evolv.com/certifications-and-awards/) web page. Evolv®, Evolv Express®, Evolv Insights®, and Evolv eXpedite™ are registered trademarks or trademarks of Evolv Technologies, Inc. in the United States and other jurisdictions. For more information, visit[evolv.com](https://evolv.com/) .
